confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Lijiang's tourist pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation and bar prices vary more by location (Old Town vs. New Town) and by season. The reference window is July 2026, a peak domestic tourist period, so accommodation is set at peak-season levels. The FX observation came from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA homepage and was not independently opened on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is other mid-sized Yunnan and southwest China tourist destinations with similar old-town restaurant and guesthouse markets (e.g., Dali, Guilin), adjusted for Lijiang's higher-altitude heritage-town tourism pricing. Cocktail and wine anchors were set using the local beer-to-bar price relationship because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
